scope.basis: Official Microsoft AI curriculum under MIT license; actual entry HTML declares the jsDelivr assets. Same-origin text dependencies may only come from observed first-pass fetch/xhr requests.
boundaries: All requests use production Fetcher policy, robots, per-hop public DNS/IP and original-host TLS checks.
No fixture script, report XML, guessed API, user browser state, remote browser HTTP, media or credential input.
Preserve first request failure and do not rerun or replace the course. Two offline passes share one deadline and budgets.
Operating-system-wide browser/background/UDP egress remains unknown. Page HTTP is manifest fulfill or abort only.
Compare the same fetched HTML against actual JS-generated DOM. Course outline does not prove video availability or playback.
scope.repair: Fetch first actual blocked text dependency and replay once; deferred fallback cannot trigger a second-pass failure unless still actually requested. No third pass.
